# Helmian

Helmian lets a person run Claude, ChatGPT, Grok and Gemini on one project without them stepping on each other. One agent holds write access at a time, risky steps wait for human sign-off, and every action lands in an audit trail.

## The Guard family

- Helmian Guard: a browser extension that helps teams notice potentially harmful and hedging AI actions before they move forward.
- Executive Guard: the approvals server. When an agent wants to do something that needs a human OK, nothing runs until the person chooses Allow or Deny.
- Helmian Site Guard: website protection. It screens what visitors send a website's AI, blocks the dangerous classes before the AI acts, and keeps its records free of message content.
